task.title: Configuring On-Behalf-Of (OBO) flows
task.shortdesc: To allow an upstream service to call Red Hat Quay APIs on behalf of authenticated users, you can configure On-Behalf-Of (OBO) audiences and allowed clients in your Entra ID OIDC settings.

step.cmd: In the Azure Portal, expose an API on the Red Hat Quay app registration and add a scope, for example registry.access under api://quay-api.
Create a second app registration for the upstream service and grant it permission to the Red Hat Quay API scope.
Add the exposed API identifier to OIDC_AUDIENCES in your Red Hat Quay configuration, for example api://quay-api.
Add the upstream application’s client ID to OIDC_ALLOWED_CLIENTS.

info.p: OBO tokens have aud: api://quay-api and azp: <upstream_client_id>. Red Hat Quay validates both claims.
